title: feat(plugin-detail): the default record page shows Activity last — right column, stack, tab row and strip
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34590

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：没有手写记录页的对象，默认记录页把「动态」放到最后——宽屏右栏是 相关 → 附件 → 审批 → 动态；窄屏单列是 详情 → 相关 → 附件 → 审批 → 动态；顶部页签行是 概览 → 各关联 → 动态；合成的页签条（Studio 新建记录页的初始内容）也是 详情 → 相关 → 审批 → 动态。
- 为什么改：维护者 2026-11-17 原话「我们同事反馈动态不常用，是否建议移动到子表最后」「「动态」在最后」，并在 6937542160 裁决「同意」：第 2 项（对象级开关）不做，窄屏动态页签也移到最后。
- 风险与回滚：只改默认页的排列顺序，不改任何元数据、键名和 `?tab=` 取值；手写记录页不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`（右栏顺序与页签行，含"首批计数未回时动态页签暂不上行"一段）、`synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`（页签条顺序）、`__tests__/RecordPageColumns.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 #34590 用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.test.tsx`，预期 18 个用例全绿；或在控制台打开任一无手写页的记录，右栏最下方是「动态」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On the synthesized default record page (no hand-written page), the Activity stream (动态) now comes last on every surface that draws it:

- **Right column** (two-column and wide tiers): related panels in the reader's arrangement, then attachments, then approvals, then the 动态 panel. Any related-stack foot line (hidden count, restore default order) stays with the related panels, above 动态.
- **Single-column stack** (below 760 px, a phone, the split pane): details, related panels, attachments, approvals, 动态 at the very bottom of the page.
- **Tab row**: 概览, the related panels' tabs, then 动态. Because 动态 now sits after the panel tabs, it waits off the row together with them while their first count set is out (unless it is the active tab), so no tab moves when the counts land; the row itself is drawn from the first paint (概览 alone meanwhile), so the page below it does not shift. This keeps the existing no-move rule of #28469 Target 2.
- **Synthesized `page:tabs` strip** (`buildDefaultTabs` / `buildDefaultPageSchema`, also what Studio seeds a new record page with): Details, Related, Approvals, then the Activity stream. Tab `value`s are unchanged, so `?tab=` links keep working.

Hand-written record pages keep their author's order. No metadata key is added (item 2 of the card was dropped by the maintainer's ruling, comment 6937542160).

**Supersession.** #27524 Targets 5 and 8 (maintainer rulings of 2026-10-29: 动态 the first panel of the right column, and second in the tab row) are superseded for the right column, the stack, the tab row and the strip by the maintainer's 2026-11-17 words 「我们同事反馈动态不常用，是否建议移动到子表最后」「「动态」在最后」 and the ruling recorded in 6937542160 (「同意」). Every changed assertion that pinned those targets cites this.

**Surface extension (area o3-A).** The claim's surface was extended by the area for assertion-only edits to tests outside it that pinned the old order: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052.test.tsx`, `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`. No source file outside the original surface changed. Claim amendment 6939020563 then added, comment and doc text only: `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (the synthesized-default section now states the new right-column and tab-row order), and the comments in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordTabRow.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx`.

## Why

Members open the related records much more often than the stream; the maintainer asked for 动态 to move after the child tables (quoted above).

## Tests

New pins (a top-level `describe` in `RecordPageColumns.test.tsx`, the component's existing harness file, per the shared-harness rule in AGENTS.md, rather than a new per-card file): wide, two-column and stack, each with attachments on or off (`enable.files`) and approvals on or off (12 cases), plus a reader-rearranged stack (foot line, then 动态 last) and a page with the stream off.

Assertions updated as this card's intended behaviour change, each citing #34590:

- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.test.tsx` (3 right-column order pins, 1 first-child pin)
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.switches-27052.test.tsx` (2)
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.tabRow-27524.test.tsx` (3 tab-row order pins)
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordTabRow.recordsFirst-28469.test.tsx` (6: final order, plus the pending row that is now 概览 alone)
- `plugin-detail/src/synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts` (every strip-order pin, in 9 tests), `buildDefaultPageSchema.strictPayload.test.ts` (2), `buildDefaultPageSchema.bodyTables-27055.test.ts` (2), `recordPageColumns.switches-27052.test.ts` (1)
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordTimelinePanel-27524.test.tsx` (docblock only)
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678.test.tsx` (4), `RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052.test.tsx` (1), `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` (1)

## Acceptance notes

- On a narrow row with many panels, 动态 can now fall into the 「+N ▾」 dropdown (it used to be guaranteed a slot as the second tab). That follows from "动态 last" under the row's existing fit rule.
- The `RecordTabRow` component tests in `RecordTabRow.recordsFirst-28469.test.tsx` (the first describe) feed the component a fixed tab list with 动态 second; they pin the width rule, not the page's order, and were left as they are.
